# GlobalShip Logistics

> GlobalShip Logistics is a premier supply chain, multi-modal freight, and corporate logistics partner in India. Slogan: "Moving Business Beyond Boundaries" / "Procure | Collate | Pack | Ship".

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Domestic Logistics](https://globalshiplogistics.com/services#domestic): Standard Premium ground-based delivery network covering over 19,000+ pincodes across India with day-definite reliability and competitive B2B commercial rates.
- [International & Air Logistics](https://globalshiplogistics.com/services#international): Day-definite air cargo express with next-day (2,000+ pincodes) and second-day (3,000+ pincodes) milk run delivery.
- [PTL & FTL Freight](https://globalshiplogistics.com/services#ptl-ftl): Flexible part-truckload (PTL/LTL) and dedicated full-truckload (FTL) commercial transportation across national corridors.
- [Rail Logistics](https://globalshiplogistics.com/services#rail): High-capacity, cost-effective rail freight connecting major industrial hubs and production centers across India.
- [Warehousing & Inventory Management](https://globalshiplogistics.com/services#warehousing): Secure warehousing, collation, customized packaging, and distributed inventory management.
- [Corporate Gifting & Packaging](https://globalshiplogistics.com/): End-to-end gift procurement, custom branding, personalized packaging, and doorstep distribution.

## Key Network Scale & Metrics

- **Surface Delivery Network**: 19,000+ Pincodes across India
- **Air Express Milk Run (Day 1)**: 2,000+ Pincodes (Next-Day Delivery)
- **Air Express Milk Run (Day 2)**: 3,000+ Pincodes (Second-Day Delivery)
- **Enterprise Clients**: 100+ Trusted Corporate Partners (including Vijay Sales, Pantaloons, VIP Industries, Donear Industries, Actis Technologies, Innovcare Lifesciences, Hetero Healthcare, etc.)
- **Milestone Tracking**: 100% end-to-end checkpoint visibility and dedicated customer care.
